title: Neutrino Properties
description: Essential Criteria: The response must list the general properties of neutrinos and antineutrinos, including their classification as leptons and weakly interacting particles.

title: Physical Motivation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must explain the physical motivation for the postulate of the neutrino's existence, specifically relating to the energy spectrum in beta decay.

title: Detection Method
description: Essential Criteria: The response must describe the method used for the first direct detection of neutrinos, including the experiment by Reines and Cowan.

title: Quantum Numbers
description: Important Criteria: The response should mention the specific types of neutrinos and their antiparticles, such as electron, muon, and tau neutrinos.

title: Decay Process
description: Important Criteria: The response should include the decay process involved in the detection of neutrinos, specifically the neutron decay reaction.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid common errors such as misidentifying the types of neutrinos or incorrectly stating the detection method.

title: Energy Spectrum
description: Optional Criteria: The response could discuss the significance of the continuous energy spectrum in beta decay and its implications for neutrino physics.

title: Historical Context
description: Optional Criteria: The response could provide additional historical context regarding the development of neutrino theory and its implications in particle physics.
